observedSql.normalizedSql: SELECT u.id, u."stripeCustomerId", u."stripeSubscriptionId", u."workosUserId", u."deletionRequestedAt" FROM "User" AS u WHERE u.id = $1 AND u."isBanned" = true AND u."deletionRequestedAt" <= $2 FOR UPDATE

UPDATE "public"."DeletionJob" SET "status" = $1, "updatedAt" = $2 WHERE ("public"."DeletionJob"."id" = $3 AND ("public"."DeletionJob"."status" = $4 OR ("public"."DeletionJob"."status" = $5 AND "public"."DeletionJob"."updatedAt" <= $6)))

WITH targets AS ( SELECT a.id FROM "AgentRun" AS a WHERE a."userId" = $1 ORDER BY a.id ASC LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE "AgentRun" AS target SET "userId" = NULL, "inputJson" = '{}', "outputJson" = NULL, "toolInvocations" = NULL, "createdMemoryIds" = NULL, error = NULL FROM targets WHERE target.id = targets.id RETURNING target.id

WITH targets AS ( SELECT c.id FROM "ConversationContext" AS c WHERE c."userId" = $1 ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) DELETE FROM "ConversationContext" AS target USING targets WHERE target.id = targets.id RETURNING target.id

WITH targets AS ( SELECT l.id FROM "Listing" AS l WHERE l."profileId" = $1 AND ( l.title IS DISTINCT FROM $2 OR l.description IS DISTINCT FROM $3 OR l.price IS NOT NULL OR l.state IS NOT NULL OR l."dogId" IS NOT NULL OR l."imageUrl" IS NOT NULL OR l.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'archived' OR l."archivedAt" IS NULL ) ORDER BY l.id ASC LIMIT $4 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE "Listing" AS target SET title = $5, description = $6, price = NULL, state = NULL, "dogId" = NULL, "imageUrl" = NULL, status = 'archived', "archivedAt" = $7, "updatedAt" = $8 FROM targets WHERE target.id = targets.id RETURNING target.id

WITH targets AS ( SELECT m.id FROM "MediaAsset" AS m WHERE m."uploaderId" = $1 AND m."deletedAt" IS NULL ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE "MediaAsset" AS target SET "originalName" = NULL, sha256 = NULL, "deletedAt" = $3, "updatedAt" = $4 FROM targets WHERE target.id = targets.id RETURNING target.id

WITH targets AS ( SELECT m.id FROM "MemoryEntry" AS m WHERE m."userId" = $1 AND m."deletedAt" IS NULL ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE "MemoryEntry" AS target SET content = $3, "sourceRef" = NULL, importance = 0.1, "deletedAt" = $4, "updatedAt" = $5 FROM targets WHERE target.id = targets.id RETURNING target.id

WITH targets AS ( SELECT m.id FROM "Message" AS m WHERE m."senderId" = $1 AND ( m.body IS DISTINCT FROM $2 OR m."mediaIdsJson" IS NOT NULL OR m."deletedBySenderAt" IS NULL ) ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT $3 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE "Message" AS target SET body = $4, "mediaIdsJson" = NULL, "deletedBySenderAt" = $5 FROM targets WHERE target.id = targets.id RETURNING target.id

WITH targets AS ( SELECT p.id FROM "Post" AS p WHERE p."authorId" = $1 AND p.body IS DISTINCT FROM $2 ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT $3 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE "Post" AS target SET body = $4, "editedAt" = $5 FROM targets WHERE target.id = targets.id RETURNING target.id

WITH targets AS ( SELECT t.id FROM "Thread" AS t WHERE t."authorId" = $1 AND ( t.title IS DISTINCT FROM $2 OR t.locked = false ) ORDER BY t.id ASC LIMIT $3 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE "Thread" AS target SET title = $4, locked = true, "updatedAt" = $5 FROM targets WHERE target.id = targets.id RETURNING target.id
